settings.delivery: one-way input and correction delay = profile.delay * 50 ms; FIFO ordered events
settings.stamps: input tick = synthetic send tick + profile.delay + 1; no client clock model
settings.sampling: after every input/correction operation; contacts after every new-input and replay solver step
settings.controls: exact and repeat receive identical unrounded projections from the same authoritative game
settings.events: Each profile stores exact.coverage.events in full; other variants store eventsRef = exact.coverage.events when their event arrays deeply match, otherwise their own full events array.
settings.hashes: SHA-256 of working-tree bytes; commit pins repository sources, including line-ending normalization

limitations: Synthetic ordered tick deliveries; no socket or browser scheduling. Existing jitter, reconnect, background, hidden-contact, stale-door and burst profiles are not reproduced.
Fallbacks are injected into production projections; generated geometry uses the stored seed 9 map.
Proxy lists record delivered candidates, while contact IDs demonstrate actual island inclusion.

Qualification requires every profile to pass and every selected field to be perturbed somewhere in the workload. Proxies are fixed, so their velocity and omega are not consumed by the predictor; own body omega and player heading are also not consumed by the motor solve.
